description: Extend the marker system to include '×' (cross) and '+' (plus) symbols as additional marker options. These new markers will be particularly useful in scatter plot visualizations where multiple data series need clear visual differentiation.
functional_requirements: Add '×' and '+' symbols to the marker enum in the symbols module
Update the marker rendering logic to properly display these new symbols on canvas
Ensure the new markers are available for use in chart widgets, particularly scatter plots
Update example applications to demonstrate usage of the new markers
Maintain backward compatibility with existing marker types
Ensure proper visual spacing and alignment for the new marker symbols
